note: Same worklist read after a run that found nothing (a TABL): atcworklist:objects and atcworklist:infos are both empty, and five object sets are listed (ALL, LAST_RUN, and three kind="PACKAGE" sets, one per package ever run into this worklist) — object sets accumulate across runs.
